definitions.sets: Distinct normalized AL numbers. RNAL: official Concelho=Lisboa and official Freguesia. Airbnb: observed municipality=Lisboa and observed parish. City sets are computed independently, never summed from parishes.
definitions.differences: RNAL-only means absent from Airbnb in the same geography, not absent elsewhere. Airbnb-only does not imply absence from national RNAL.
definitions.difference_priority: Among Airbnb-only numbers: no national record; unresolved if any matching official record has missing/unknown municipality, unknown Lisbon parish (district scope), or conflicting municipality/parish; otherwise another Lisbon parish or another municipality. Multiple identical entries count once in sets.
definitions.announcements: Empty (nil or whitespace), filled unrecognised, identifiable are disjoint and sum to all observed Lisbon announcements. Confirmed match is a subset of identifiable: number present in dated national RNAL, without asserting validity, activity or geography.
definitions.entries: Official CSV rows with declared Concelho=Lisboa; duplicates retained in entry counts, deduplicated in number sets. Unparseable official numbers excluded from sets and diagnosed.
definitions.geography: Trim, case and accent normalization; explicit aliases for Inside Airbnb's missing accented letters; 24 Lisbon parishes. Missing/unrecognized parishes pooled in Geografia não identificada and excluded from known parish sets; included in city totals. Nonempty nonsentinel national municipality names are accepted as declared, not independently validated.
definitions.denominators: Set differences use distinct numbers in the local Airbnb or RNAL set. Announcement counts use observed Lisbon rows. No implicit percentages. Parish totals and establishment estimates are not additive across the city.
definitions.classification: Priority: empty/unrecognized; known outside municipality; unresolved observed coordinates; multiple spatial clusters; no national match; unresolved official municipality; single Lisbon match; probable multiple units; repeated same location. Metadados de anfitrião nunca agrupam anúncios. Clusters are connected components of edges <=500m, so chain endpoints may exceed 500m; missing coordinates remain singleton clusters.
definitions.estimate: One per matched Lisbon number in either lower-risk same-location category, plus every announcement in all other categories. Calculated independently in each geography; no collapsing unmatched, outside or unresolved cases. Indicator, not legal finding.
